# Upgrade, Rollback, and Release Acceptance {#sec-upgrade}

## Upgrade

1. Keep the previous validated release and model asset directory intact.
2. Place the new clean checkout at a separate path.
3. Run the one-time model setup on the new release if its verified assets are not already present.
4. Run backend tests, Ruff, frontend tests, typecheck, and the production build.
5. Start the new Model API, run the health and model metadata checks, and perform one public or synthetic smoke inference.
6. Connect a review workstation and verify `/app/`, dataset export, and **Models & Audit**.
7. Record the release SHA, software version, model asset hashes, and acceptance result before switching the service configuration.

## Rollback

Stop the service, restore the previous release and configuration, verify the previous asset hashes, and restart. Do not overwrite verified model assets in place. Preserve the failed release for investigation according to hospital policy.

```{=latex}
\Needspace{22\baselineskip}
```

## Troubleshooting

| Observation | Action |
|:------------|:-------|
| `READY` is not printed | Read the setup error. Check Python, dependencies, CUDA, source revisions, checkpoint hashes, and storage. |
| Startup fails verification | Treat changed or missing assets as a deliberate fail-closed state. Reacquire through the controlled online setup. |
| `/health` is not `PASS` | Check service logs, CUDA visibility, environment values, port binding, and asset verification. |
| `/v1/models` lacks a model | Check local assets and the configured provider package. Do not substitute a different model. |
| Workstation cannot infer | Check `REMOTE_MODEL_URL`, token handling, firewall policy, and Model API health. Human review and export remain available. |
| DICOM is unsupported | A non-fundus DICOM is reported as **Unsupported modality**. Do not expand support to MRI, OCT, PACS, or DICOMweb. |

: {tbl-colwidths="[30,70]"}

## Release acceptance

Record the release SHA and confirm:

```{=latex}
\begin{multicols}{2}
```

- clean-clone installation succeeds;
- the frontend production build succeeds;
- the review workstation opens at `/app/`;
- one-time model setup verifies pinned sources and prints `READY`;
- normal startup is offline-safe;
- `/health` and `/v1/models` pass;
- one public or synthetic image completes the supported inference path;
- dataset export contains the documented manifest and CSV files;
- no secrets, PHI, model weights, or runtime databases are tracked;
- the clinician and operator manuals render successfully.

```{=latex}
\end{multicols}
```
